result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it creates a mutual, agreement-wide aggregate cap equal to the greater of paid or payable 12-month fees and USD 1,000,000; mutually excludes indirect and consequential damages; includes all required uncapped carve-outs; and excludes Client payment obligations from the limitation. The indemnity language is otherwise preserved, and the changes are limited to those needed to implement the playbook. Drafting is professional, though “immediately preceding 12 months period” should ideally specify that the period precedes the claim, and “total aggregate” is redundant.
